feature: Correct server addresses without losing privacy or the previous destination

scenarios.name: Correct a rejected Ollama address and explain omitted URL parts
scenarios.given: an explicit Ollama server is saved and Settings is open
scenarios.when: the user submits a disallowed HTTP address, closes and reopens Settings, and enters an HTTPS address containing a path and query into the empty draft
scenarios.then: the rejection explains HTTPS recovery and preserves the previous server; the corrected address is entered exactly, only its scheme, host and port are saved, and the omission notice does not expose the query value

scenarios.name: Correct an OpenAI-compatible address and identify the chosen server
scenarios.given: the user explicitly chooses an unconfigured OpenAI-compatible provider
scenarios.when: Settings rejects a numeric HTTP address and the user closes and reopens Settings before entering a local server address into the empty draft
scenarios.then: the rejection has a recovery reason, the replacement is entered exactly, the saved destination is labelled as the user's server rather than on-device AI, and context capacity and server removal remain available
